name: GOL Linhas Areas InteligentesRe
summary: GOL Linhas Areas InteligentesRe represents shares of Gol Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes S.A., a Brazilian airline company. The company provides passenger and cargo air transportation services in Brazil and other South American countries. Gol Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes S.A. is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
